title: 7-day motor imagery BCI EEG dataset from Zhou et al 2021
description: A longitudinal motor imagery brain-computer interface EEG dataset in which 20 healthy participants each completed seven sessions on separate days without feedback training. Four classes were recorded (left hand, right hand, both feet, rest) with a 41-channel Neuroscan system at 500 Hz, yielding 33,600 trials. The dataset supports research on the stability of motor imagery decoding across days and subjects.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier (Ag/AgCl electrodes, 500 Hz, 0.5-100 Hz bandpass, 50 Hz notch, Cz reference, AFz ground). Each session had 6 runs of 40 trials. Trials used visual arrow cues and 5 s of imagery without feedback. Benchmark analysis used CSP features with an SVM classifier in 8-30 Hz and 10-fold within-session cross-validation.
